plugins.title: Easypanel Deploy
plugins.notes:
Creates and deploys an app service in Easypanel from a GitHub repository (Dockerfile build). Monitors the deploy and reports success or failure.

Note: The API token must be set on the easypanel_token parameter.

params.title: Easypanel URL
params.notes: Base URL of your Easypanel instance, without trailing slash. Example: https://panel.example.com

params.title: Easypanel API Token
params.notes: Easypanel API token. Set the default value here so all events share the same token. To use a different token per event, change the field type to text.

params.title: Project Name
params.notes: Easypanel project name. Only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores are allowed.

params.title: Service Name
params.notes: Base name for the ephemeral service. If 'Use service name as prefix' is checked, the job ID will be appended as a suffix to guarantee uniqueness.

params.title: Use service name as prefix (append job ID)
params.notes: When checked, the final service name will be: {service_name}-{job_id}. When unchecked, the exact name is used (note: concurrent jobs may conflict).

params.title: GitHub Owner
params.notes: GitHub user or organization that owns the repository.

params.title: Build Path
params.notes: Path inside the repository where the Dockerfile is located. Use '/' for the root.

params.title: Dockerfile Path
params.notes: Dockerfile path, relative to Build Path. Example: Dockerfile or docker/Dockerfile

params.title: Runtime Command (optional)
params.notes: Runtime command to override the Dockerfile CMD. Corresponds to the 'Advanced -> Command' field in Easypanel. Leave empty to use the image default.

params.title: Environment Variables (JSON)
params.notes: Environment variables as a JSON object. Example: {"NODE_ENV": "production", "PORT": "3000"}
